synth.notes:
Mirror-axis puzzle on 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks (x=row). ACTION5 cycles selection axis->piece_0->piece_1->axis; ACTION1-4 move the selection one block (axis: rows only).
Moves are blocked off-board, onto the axis row or a piece row, or into another piece. Reflections = piece blocks mirrored in the axis row, clipped to the board.
Rendering: layers wall1<target2<reflection3<piece4; holes are transparent over lower pixels, else filled (0 when selected, 4 for reflection). Then re-extract 4-connected components, targets per sprite, names by bbox (x,y), wall index offset by non-wall 0 pixels.
Merged pieces are split statelessly via 0/ambiguous/empty hole centres; continuity-gated hidden state keeps identities. Passes 29/29 with and without hidden state.
Unconfirmed: what happens on win/level completion, ACTION6/7 (treated as no-ops), and the hole fill when a piece hole overlaps a reflection hole.
